thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — prepping an SLA evidence packet for BlueHarbor Health ahead of renewal. Need 30d + 90d uptime aggregates, latency percentiles, incident summaries, and a short customer-facing narrative. Can eng-sre + cs owners pull and assemble? :spiral_calendar:

Diego Flores: On it. Which latency metrics do you want surfaced? p95 primary and p99 appendix ok? Also should we include a short incidents list?

Maya Chen: Yes p95 as the main SLA stat and p99 for appendix. Include uptime % by region, error-rate, top 3 incidents with mitigations + dates. Also call out fallback/backup model usage and a worked example of how credits would be calculated.

Arjun Patel: I can pull aggregates from telemetry and make a Grafana snapshot. Need the service id + regions. @Maya Chen which service do you want?

Maya Chen: Service id = bh-prod-textgen. Regions: us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 fallback. Also note Dedicated pools for this customer (they use reserved capacity occasionally).

Lina Park: I'll draft the renewal-facing paragraph explaining credits & what to expect during the review. Quick Q: do we have legal-approved language for the credits section?

Sam Rivera: There's approved wording we can reuse: "Downtime credits are calculated pro-rata against monthly committed spend per the Terms (section 6). Credits are applied as billing adjustments on the following billing cycle." I can paste exact T&C snippet into the packet.

Diego Flores: Good. I'll also add a short "Customer impact and next steps" bullet list for the handoff to renewals. Want simulated credit examples too? e.g., mapping observed uptime to % credit.

Maya Chen: Yes please — a small table example is perfect. Timeline: internal review by Thursday EOD, customer-ready draft by Friday EOD. Can we hit that?

Arjun Patel: Will run exports now. Planned commands: ```
# fetch uptime by region for 30d
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/uptime?service=bh-prod-textgen&period=30d&group=region" | jq .
```
I'll push a CSV + Grafana snapshots to /shared/reports/blueharbor/1809991111 when done.

Diego Flores: Perfect. Once you drop CSV I'll populate the template slides. Two quick notes from the metrics side: fallback route was used 12 short times over the last 90d (sub-second bursts), and error-rate spikes align with a DB flapping incident on 2027-06-02.

Arjun Patel: Uploaded files: /shared/reports/blueharbor/1809991111/metrics.csv and grafana-snapshots.tar.gz. Raw summary: uptime_us-west-2,99.947; uptime_eu-west-1,99.991; p95_us-west-2,165ms; p99_us-west-2,410ms; fallback_count_90d,12.

Diego Flores: Draft slide deck is at same path. I added an "Operational explanation" slide explaining short fallback behavior and mitigation steps.

Maya Chen: Quick ask — include a worked credits calc inline in the packet. Diego, can you drop the calc here so I can copy?

Diego Flores: Example calc: 
- Monthly commit = $50,000
- SLA tiers: 
  - >=99.95% = no credit
  - 99.9% - 99.95% = 5% credit
  - 99.0% - 99.9% = 10% credit
- Observed (30d, us-west-2) = 99.947% -> falls into 99.9-99.95 => 5% credit = $2,500
(We can present both regional and global combined examples.) :white_check_mark:

Sam Rivera: I'll review the customer wording and flag any edits to the credits language. If everyone agrees on the timeline I'll provide the exact T&C text by Wed.

Lina Park: I'll draft the customer-facing paragraph and an FAQ entry for "What triggers a credit". Will sync with legal text before Friday.

Maya Chen: Great. Final checklist for internal review Thu: metrics CSV, Grafana snapshots, slide deck, legal blurb, credits table, one-page narrative. Ping here when each item is uploaded. Thanks team :heart: 

Arjun Patel: Uploaded metrics + snapshots at 1809991111.

Diego Flores: Uploaded slides and sample credit table.

Sam Rivera: Legal text uploaded to the folder.

Maya Chen: All items received — I'll run the internal review Thu morning and share a consolidated draft. If anything blocks, call it out here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
